supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Significant extension beyond the outer corner of the ocular orbit in the lateral plane

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the light-toned muzzle area and the dark-toned cheek and periocular regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness with a distinct structural droop of the lower lip

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced light pigmentation/mottling on the chin and lower labial region
